_doc: Recurring characters drawn in rooms and scenes (not the talking heads: heads.json). A room or scene part names one with "character" and takes its prompt, negatives, seed and settings; the part's own keys win. One description and one seed per character keep it the same person everywhere. context: false draws the character from the pixel art alone, not over the room's rendering, so the room's settings do not change him.
